_meta.description: Phase 2: order extensions via JSON-Schema allOf composition onto the base Order. Grant (subsidie) is folded here as one rich English schema; award amounts map to Order.totalAmount and the disbursement/reclaim amounts become Payment rows.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: A subsidy/grant — an Order of orderType=grant. Folds the former Subsidie schemas (Dutch + English) into one rich English schema (Awb 4.2 / ASV-model). The award amount is Order.totalAmount; disbursements (uitbetaald) and reclaims (teruggevorderd) are Payment rows; the performance report and auditor statement are related objects. Inherits orderType/direction/counterparty/currency/totalAmount/state/paymentTerms from Order via allOf.

schemeArticle.description: Scheme article the award rests on (regelingArtikel).
schemeArticle.title: Scheme Article

granteeOrganization.description: The organisation receiving the grant (when we award) — counterpartyName covers the inbound case.
granteeOrganization.title: Grantee Organization

budgetYear.description: Budget year the award is charged to.
budgetYear.title: Budget Year

approvingAuthority.description: The authority that issued the beschikking.
approvingAuthority.title: Approving Authority

applicationDate.description: Date the grant was applied for (aanvraagDate).
applicationDate.title: Application Date

appliedAmount.description: Amount applied for (aangevraagdBedrag); the granted amount is Order.totalAmount.
appliedAmount.title: Applied Amount

hasRepaymentPlan.description: Whether a reclaim repayment plan exists.
hasRepaymentPlan.title: Has Repayment Plan

repaymentPlanId.description: FK to the reclaim repayment plan (preserved from the folded Subsidie).
repaymentPlanId.title: Repayment Plan ID
